      "path": "README.md",
      "content": "﻿# dsh-blend-preview

Preview Blender **`.blend`** files inside [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai): the right-Sidebar document preview turns the scene into an interactive 3D viewport (orbit / zoom / wireframe) with a scene-information panel, instead of the built-in “binary file, no preview” empty state.

![The preview inside the DSH right Sidebar](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/439436269-ctrl/dsh-blend-preview/main/docs/blender-preview.png)

## What it does

- Registers a document-preview renderer for `.blend` files, so clicking one in **Workspace files** opens it in the right Sidebar.
- Runs `blender --background` once per file version to export a **GLB** plus a scene JSON (objects, triangles, materials, real-world size in mm, units, cameras, lights, collections).
- Draws the GLB with a small **dependency-free WebGL viewer** written for this plugin: orbit, pan, wheel zoom, double-click reset, wireframe mode, auto-rotate, a soft contact shadow and an axis triad. No CDN, no three.js.
- Caches conversions under `~/.dsh/cache/blend-preview`; the second open is instant (a few milliseconds).
- Shows the scene facts that matter for CAD/3D-printing work: per-object triangle counts and bounding-box sizes in millimetres, material swatches, scene units.

## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x (declared compatible with `0.2.0-rc.2` and `0.2.1-rc.2`).
- **Blender 3.6 / 4.x / 5.x** installed. The plugin auto-detects `DSH_BLENDER`, `BLENDER_PATH`, `blender` on `PATH`, the Steam library, and `C:\Program Files\Blender Foundation\Blender*`. Set `blenderPath` if your install lives elsewhere.
- A browser/GPU with WebGL (the DSH desktop app always has it).

## Install

```sh
# into a normal (non-desktop) profile
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-blend-preview

# the desktop profile is owned by the Electron app; add it there through the
# plugin manager UI, or compose it manually and restart the app
```

The package ships a `cordis.patch.yml`, so installation adds the plugin row automatically. Restart DSH after installing.

## Configuration

Settings → Plugins → **Blender preview** (namespace `blend-preview`):

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | Register the renderer and the conversion route. |
| `routePath` | `/api/blend-preview` | Authenticated conversion route. Must stay under `/api`; otherwise the authenticated fence is bypassed, so it falls back to the default. |
| `extensions` | `["blend"]` | Suffixes that open in the 3D preview. |
| `blenderPath` | `""` (auto) | Absolute path of `blender.exe` / `blender`. |
| `cacheDir` | `""` → `~/.dsh/cache/blend-preview` | Where exported GLB files and scene JSON live. |
| `timeoutMs` | `180000` | Wall-clock ceiling for one cold conversion. |
| `maxBytes` | `1073741824` | Largest `.blend` converted (1 GiB). |
| `applyModifiers` | `true` | Apply modifiers during export, so the preview matches what Blender renders. |
| `cacheEntries` | `24` | Cached conversions kept on disk before the oldest are pruned. |

## How it works

```
Workspace file click
        │
        ▼
document preview body (lib/client.js)
        │  GET /api/blend-preview?path=…&kind=info   (scene JSON)
        │  GET /api/blend-preview?path=…&kind=glb    (model bytes)
        ▼
Host half (lib/index.js, lib/route.js)
        │  cache key = sha1(realpath, size, mtime, recipe, modifiers)
        ▼
lib/blender.js ── spawn blender --background --python lib/scene.py
        │            → model.glb + scene.json (+ meta.json)
        ▼
~/.dsh/cache/blend-preview/<key>/
```

- `lib/scene.py` exports with `export_apply`, `use_visible`, **Y-up**, no cameras/lights, and writes the scene description (world-space AABBs through the evaluated depsgraph, Principled base colours converted to sRGB swatches).
- The route lives under `/api`, so the connection service authenticates every request (Host/Origin fence + session cookie). Arbitrary local files are not exposed.
- The viewer is a hand-written glTF 2.0 subset renderer (POSITION + NORMAL, indexed triangles, PBR factors, node TRS/matrix). Textures, skinning and animation are out of scope; the Host only exports still scenes.

## Development

```
dev/client-body.js   client UI (single CJS factory for the DSH module loader)
dev/viewer.js        the WebGL renderer, spliced into the bundle at build time
scripts/build-client.mjs   builds lib/client.js from the two files
scripts/e2e-browser.mjs    Playwright end-to-end against a temporary DSH host
scripts/live-selftest.mjs  cold/warm/concurrent conversion against a real .blend
node --test test/*.test.js
```

`lib/client.js` is generated — edit the files under `dev/` and rebuild. The DSH client loader hands the bundle a `require` limited to the platform seed modules, so the package cannot pull a renderer dependency at runtime; the single generated file is the intended shape.

## Notes and limits

- A cold conversion takes roughly 2–10 s for a small scene (Blender startup dominates); it is cached per file version, so rotating/zooming never re-runs Blender.
- Very large scenes (millions of triangles) export slowly and may exceed `timeoutMs`.
- Textures are not shown in the viewport (base colours only); the Blender renders next to the file are still the reference.
- Nothing is uploaded: Blender runs locally and the GLB stays in the local cache.

      "path": "README.zh.md",
      "content": "﻿# dsh-blend-preview

在 DeepSeek Harness 的右侧栏文档预览里直接打开 Blender **`.blend`** 文件：用 Blender 后台导出一份 GLB，再用插件自带的 WebGL 视口做可旋转、可缩放的 3D 预览，并列出场景信息。

![右侧栏里的预览](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/439436269-ctrl/dsh-blend-preview/main/docs/blender-preview.png)

## 它做什么

- 给 `.blend` 注册文档预览渲染器：在工作区文件树里点一下，右侧栏就打开 3D 预览，而不是「二进制文件无法预览」。
- 每个文件版本只跑一次 `blender --background`，导出 **GLB** + 场景 JSON（对象、三角面、材质、真实尺寸 mm、单位、相机、灯光、集合）。
- 插件自带一个零依赖的 **WebGL 查看器**：拖动旋转、右键平移、滚轮缩放、双击复位、线框模式、自动旋转、接触阴影、坐标轴。不依赖 three.js，不走 CDN。
- 转换结果缓存在 `~/.dsh/cache/blend-preview`，第二次打开是毫秒级。
- 面板直接给建模/打印关心的数：每个对象的三角面数与包围盒尺寸（mm）、材质色块、场景单位。

## 依赖

- DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x（声明兼容 `0.2.0-rc.2` / `0.2.1-rc.2`）。
- **Blender 3.6 / 4.x / 5.x**。会自动找 `DSH_BLENDER`、`BLENDER_PATH`、`PATH` 里的 `blender`、Steam 库、`C:\Program Files\Blender Foundation\Blender*`；装在别处就填 `blenderPath`。
- 浏览器/显卡支持 WebGL（桌面版 DSH 天然满足）。

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-blend-preview
```

桌面版（desktop profile）由 Electron 应用管着，用设置页的插件管理器安装，或手工装入后重启应用。包内自带 `cordis.patch.yml`，装好即自动挂载。**装完重启 DSH。**

## 配置

设置 → 插件 → **Blender preview**（命名空间 `blend-preview`）：

| 键 | 默认 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | 是否注册渲染器与转换路由。 |
| `routePath` | `/api/blend-preview` | 带鉴权的转换路由；必须留在 `/api` 下，否则回落到默认值（防止裸路由读本地文件）。 |
| `extensions` | `["blend"]` | 走 3D 预览的后缀。 |
| `blenderPath` | `""`（自动） | `blender.exe` / `blender` 的绝对路径。 |
| `cacheDir` | `""` → `~/.dsh/cache/blend-preview` | GLB 与场景 JSON 的缓存目录。 |
| `timeoutMs` | `180000` | 单次冷转换的墙钟上限。 |
| `maxBytes` | `1073741824` | 允许转换的最大 `.blend`（1 GiB）。 |
| `applyModifiers` | `true` | 导出时应用修改器，预览与 Blender 渲染一致。 |
| `cacheEntries` | `24` | 磁盘上保留多少个缓存条目，超出按最旧淘汰。 |

## 工作原理

```
点击工作区里的 .blend
        │
        ▼
文档预览 body（lib/client.js）
        │  GET /api/blend-preview?path=…&kind=info   （场景 JSON）
        │  GET /api/blend-preview?path=…&kind=glb    （模型字节）
        ▼
Host 半（lib/index.js、lib/route.js）
        │  缓存键 = sha1(realpath, size, mtime, recipe, modifiers)
        ▼
lib/blender.js ── spawn blender --background --python lib/scene.py
        │            → model.glb + scene.json（+ meta.json）
        ▼
~/.dsh/cache/blend-preview/<key>/
```

- `lib/scene.py` 以 `export_apply`、`use_visible`、**Y-up** 导出，不带相机/灯光；场景描述里的世界包围盒走 evaluated depsgraph（含修改器），材质底色从线性色转成 sRGB 色块。
- 路由挂在 `/api` 下，请求先经过 connection 服务的鉴权（Host/Origin + 会话 cookie），不会把任意本地文件暴露成裸接口。
- 查看器是手写的 glTF 2.0 子集渲染（POSITION + NORMAL、索引三角形、PBR 因子、节点 TRS/矩阵）。纹理、蒙皮、动画不在范围内——Host 只导出静帧场景。

## 开发

```
dev/client-body.js   客户端 UI（DSH 模块加载器要求的单个 CJS 工厂）
dev/viewer.js        WebGL 渲染器，构建时拼进 bundle
scripts/build-client.mjs   由上面两个文件生成 lib/client.js
scripts/e2e-browser.mjs    针对临时 DSH 实例的 Playwright 端到端
scripts/live-selftest.mjs  真实 .blend 的冷/热/并发转换自检
node --test test/*.test.js
```

`lib/client.js` 是生成物——改 `dev/` 下的文件后重新构建。DSH 客户端加载器只给 bundle 一枚受限的 `require`（平台种子模块），不能在运行时拉 three.js，所以「单文件产物」是刻意设计。

## 已知边界

- 冷转换小场景约 2–10 秒（Blender 启动为主），之后按文件版本命中缓存，旋转/缩放不会重跑 Blender。
- 超大场景（数百万三角面）导出慢，可能超过 `timeoutMs`。
- 视口只显示底色，不显示纹理；纹理效果仍以 Blender 渲染图为准。
- 不上传任何文件：Blender 在本机跑，GLB 只留在本地缓存。

      "path": "lib/index.js",
      "content": "/**
 * dsh-blend-preview — open a Blender .blend in the DSH right-Sidebar document
 * preview instead of the built-in "binary file, no preview" empty state.
 *
 * Two halves, one package:
 * - this file is the Host half: it owns the conversion service (one Blender
 *   process per file version, cached on disk) and registers an authenticated
 *   `GET|HEAD /api/blend-preview` route that serves the scene JSON and the
 *   exported GLB.
 * - `./client` is the browser half: it registers a document-preview renderer
 *   for `.blend` suffixes and draws the GLB in a small WebGL viewport with
 *   orbit/zoom, a wireframe mode, and a scene-information panel.
 *
 * @module dsh-blend-preview
 */
import { BlendExporter } from "./blender.js";
import { resolveConfig } from "./config.js";
import { Config } from "./schema.js";
import { registerBlendRoute } from "./route.js";

/** Plugin name, also the settings-page namespace through the bundle patch. */
export const name = "blend-preview";

/** Host service the route needs: the authenticated `/api` fence. */
export const inject = ["connection"];

export { Config };

/**
 * Mount the conversion route and expose its path to the browser half.
 * @param ctx - host context carrying `connection`.
 * @param config - loader-supplied configuration.
 */
export function apply(ctx, config) {
  const settings = resolveConfig(config);
  if (!settings.enabled) return;
  const exporter = new BlendExporter(settings, { logger: ctx.logger });

    .digest("hex")

/**
 * Run a child process, capturing bounded output.
 * @param binary - executable.
 * @param args - argument vector.
 * @param options - timeout, abort signal, and the set that tracks live children.
 * @returns exit code and the captured streams.
 */
export function runProcess(binary, args, options = {}) {
  const timeoutMs = typeof options.timeoutMs === "number" ? options.timeoutMs : 60_000;
  const signal = options.signal;
  const children = options.children;
  return new Promise((resolve) => {

    let stderr = "";

    let aborted = false;
    let settled = false;
    let timer;
    let child;

      if (settled) return;
      settled = true;
      if (timer !== undefined) clearTimeout(timer);
      if (children !== undefined) children.delete(child);

        child.kill();

      aborted = true;
      stop();
    };

      child = spawn(binary, args, { windowsHide: true, env: { ...process.env, PYTHONIOENCODING: "utf-8", PYTHONUTF8: "1" } });
    } catch (error) {
      resolve({ code: -1, stdout: "", stderr: String(error), timedOut: false, aborted: false, durationMs: 0 });
      return;
    }
    if (children !== undefined) children.add(child);
    child.stdout?.on("data", (chunk) => {
      stdout = tailAround(stdout + chunk.toString("utf8"), MAX_LOG_BYTES);
    });
    child.stderr?.on("data", (chunk) => {
      stderr = tailAround(stderr + chunk.toString("utf8"), MAX_LOG_BYTES);
    });
    child.on("error", (error) => {
      stderr = tailAround(`${stderr}${String(error)}`, MAX_LOG_BYTES);
      finish({ code: -1, stdout, stderr, timedOut, aborted, durationMs: Date.now() - startedAt });
    });
    child.on("close", (code) => {
      finish({ code: code ?? -1, stdout, stderr, timedOut, aborted, durationMs: Date.now() - startedAt });
    });
    timer = setTimeout(() => {
      timedOut = true;
      stop();
    }, timeoutMs);
    if (signal !== undefined) {
      if (signal.aborted) onAbort();
      else signal.addEventListener("abort", onAbort, { once: true });

}

  return typeof text === "string" ? tailAround(text, limit) : "";

  const handle = await open(path, "r");

    const buffer = Buffer.alloc(length);
    await handle.read(buffer, 0, length, 0);
    return buffer.toString("latin1");
  } finally {
    await handle.close();
  }

/** Read and parse one JSON file. */
async function readJson(path) {
  return JSON.parse(await readFile(path, "utf8"));
}

async function writeJson(path, value) {
  const temp = `${path}.part`;
  await writeFile(temp, JSON.stringify(value, null, 2), "utf8");
  await rename(temp, path);

}

 * @param promise - the shared job.
